caption:
Desk, driving and phone: Mr Turtle's arms are forward all day, and his chest feels tight when he reaches overhead.

The chest muscles get used to that position. Remedial massage to the chest, front of the shoulder and upper back can help these areas feel easier, and it's most useful paired with movement.

Try a doorway stretch, forearms on the frame with a gentle step forward, for about 30 seconds a few times a day. Rows and band pull-aparts train the back half of the shoulder too.

Chest pain with breathlessness, sweating, nausea or pain spreading to the jaw or arm needs urgent help: call 000. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help with the rest. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
